tickets.title: Prepare spring tuition funding schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month schedule showing how much of the Marzipan Meadow College charges can come from Elin's 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, the $21,000 tuition set-aside at Teacup Comet Bank, and the $48,000 short-term Treasury fund at Paper Otter Custody without changing retirement contributions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule by December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain itemized billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized student account PDF from Marzipan Meadow College to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories, as the portal screenshot was missing this specific document.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the itemized billing packet by December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Resolve 529 balance mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the balance discrepancy for Elin's 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, which shows $67,400 on a mobile screenshot but $72,270 on the downloaded statement.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the balance mismatch by December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify payment or reimbursement workflow
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for Marzipan Meadow College, as the college portal rejected the bank verification for direct 529 payment after two attempts.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to identify the payment or reimbursement workflow by December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a separate planning track for Rowan's education funding using the existing 529 balance at Velvet Acorn Custody, expected test and application costs, and a first-year college savings target that does not rely on borrowing.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare cost-gap estimate for Rowan
tickets.text: Prepare a cost-gap estimate for Rowan's college list before the first school deposit decision to compare merit aid offers consistently, using the scholarship response calendar provided by the counselor.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the cost-gap estimate by February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare off-campus housing projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection of which rent, food, and utility amounts for Elin's off-campus apartment could fit into the education funding plan versus parent cash flow for the next academic year.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare sale-sequencing and tax estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a sale-sequencing and tax estimate for the Paper Otter taxable account at Paper Otter Custody, noting unrealized gains in the equity index fund and the separate Treasury position earmarked for tuition.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-sequencing and tax estimate by January 3, 2024.
